LanguageData.STO.Settings.ShowGlobalOverviewTab.Label: Show global trade overview tab
LanguageData.STO.Settings.ShowGlobalOverviewTab.Descr: Show the Settlement Trade Overview button in the main tab bar. This does not affect settlement-specific trade stock commands.
Show settlements only when the current map or another player home map has a powered communications console.
LanguageData.STO.Settings.RequireIndustrialTechnology: Show settlements only when their faction has Industrial technology or higher.
LanguageData.STO.Settings.LimitMaximumDistance.Label: Limit maximum distance
LanguageData.STO.Settings.LimitMaximumDistance.Descri: Show settlements only when they are within the configured number of world tiles from the current location.
LanguageData.STO.Settings.MaximumDistanceInTiles.Desc: The maximum distance from the current location when the distance limit is enabled.
LanguageData.STO.Settings.RequireReachable.Label: Require a reachable route
LanguageData.STO.Settings.RequireReachable.Descriptio: Show settlements only when a traversable ground route exists from the current location.
LanguageData.STO.Settings.RequireRoyaltyTradePermissi: When Royalty is active, show settlements only when an available colonist meets their royal title requirement. This setting has no effect when Royalty is inactive.
